title: Lead pre-commit runs biome format before verify
body: Outcome: a lead edit committed before krn verify is already biome-formatted: krn slice run --worker none pre-commit (or a lead pre-commit helper) runs biome check on changed files and fails with the fix command before the commit, so verify lint never costs a fixup/autosquash round. Evidence: t-qms15mt verify 1 lint FAIL format test/worker/scope-bypass.test.ts (.krn/runs/lead/t-qms15mt), fixed by fixup + autosquash. Proof: an observer where an unformatted lead edit makes the pre-commit stage exit non-zero naming biome, red at base by assertion.
